capabilities: create Obsidian tasks in TickTick automatically
synchronize task state bidirectionally between notes and TickTick
keep dates and times compatible with the Tasks plugin
extras: Full documentation is hosted elsewhere; the plugin only works with the Tasks emoji format, and the README carries a broad no-warranty disclaimer.
motivation: The README says only that it was built with the author's specific use cases in mind.
problem: Tasks written in Obsidian notes stay isolated from TickTick, so task state has to be maintained manually in both apps.

relations.evidence: Date/Time compatibility with the Tasks plugin.

summary: Task sync plugin that automatically creates tasks in TickTick and keeps task state between Obsidian notes and TickTick bidirectionally up to date.
